gambella-villagization.conditions_add: The World Bank's appraisal document for the second phase of the Protection of Basic Services programme, which paid the block grants in the districts where the relocations took place, restricts what the money may be spent on and sets conditions for releasing it. Sub-Program A1, the basic services grant, will finance recurrent expenditures (salaries, operations and maintenance), with capital spending left to government sources except in woredas under the pilot Local Investment Grant. Disbursement for Sub-Program A1 required the annual sub-national budget for basic services to be delivered to the Association, satisfactory outcomes of the joint budget and aid review and the performance assessment, and submission of satisfactory interim financial reports. Effectiveness required adoption of a Project Operational Manual satisfactory to IDA and the partners, and a monitoring report on compliance with the Environmental and Social Management Framework and the Resettlement Policy Framework was due three months after effectiveness and annually thereafter (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, Ethiopia Second Phase of the Protection of Basic Services Project, 2009).

kyrgyz-tariffs-2010.conditions_add: The World Bank document closest in time to the price rises sets no tariff condition. The project paper for the additional financing to the Kyrgyz Republic's Emergency Energy Assistance Project, dated November 2009, makes the additional condition of effectiveness an amended Subsidiary Credit Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and JSC Power Plants, and adds a covenant, to be set out in the Project Operational Manual, that initiating operation of the rehabilitated boilers is contingent on the electrostatic precipitators being installed and operational. It also requires audited financial statements within six months of each fiscal year end and interim financial reports within 45 days after the end of each calendar quarter. On tariffs it records only that power tariffs are low and do not allow the sector entities to recover cash expenses, and that a tariff study is required to determine longer-term development costs, to be considered through a separate proposed development policy operation (World Bank, Project Paper, Kyrgyz Republic Emergency Energy Assistance Project Additional Financing, 2009).

ixquisis-hydro-guatemala.conditions_add: IDB Invest's environmental and social review for Generadora San Mateo, the 20 MW San Mateo plant, states: "The Company will be required to carry out the actions included in the Environmental and Social Action Plan (ESAP)." The company also had to submit regular progress reports on that plan to the IIC. Because the transmission line crosses an internationally recognised key biodiversity area, the review states that the IIC will require the project to comply with the applicable requirements of IFC Performance Standard 6. The plan's items include completing a supplemental environmental impact assessment with a critical habitat assessment, expanding the biological baseline along the transmission corridor, assessing how communities use river snails, shrimp and crabs, monitoring minimum ecological flows of 750 litres a second on the Pojom river and 300 on the Negro river, and setting up a grievance mechanism for workers and affected people. The parallel review for Generadora San Andres, the 10.65 MW plant, sets the same requirements with minimum flows of 140, 100 and 80 litres a second. On land, the San Mateo review records that about 70 parcels were bought by direct negotiation with landowners and that no land was acquired through eminent domain (IDB Invest, Environmental and Social Review, Generadora San Mateo and Generadora San Andres).

why.safeguard: will be required to carry out the actions included in the Environmental and Social Action Plan (ESAP)
why.admin: submit regular progress reports on that plan to the IIC

amaravati-land-pooling.conditions_add: The World Bank's project information document and integrated safeguards data sheet for the Amaravati Sustainable Infrastructure and Institutional Development Project (P159808, a proposed US$300 million IBRD loan within a US$715 million project) states that the Bank's involuntary resettlement policy has been triggered and will be applicable to all lands that are assembled for the project, and that the Resettlement Policy Framework prepared for it is part of legal agreements. It set a cut-off date of 8 December 2014 for non-titleholders, recorded that the increased land pooling payments for 2016-18 would be paid retroactively after loan approval, required an Environmental and Social Management Framework as the environmental assessment instrument for this Category A project, required project-specific assessment by an independent agency for E1 subcomponents, required independent consultants for concurrent monitoring of resettlement, and required the capital region authority to show that three dedicated staff were in place before appraisal. The Asian Development Bank's November 2024 report and recommendation of the President for the Amaravati Inclusive and Sustainable Capital City Development Program ties its loan of 121,972,000,000 yen (about US$788.80 million) to eight disbursement-linked indicators, excludes high-risk activities including the physical displacement of people living in village clusters, and includes a program action plan item to conduct a social audit of the land assembly process and livelihood impacts at baseline, midterm and end-term (World Bank, Project Information Document/Integrated Safeguards Data Sheet, 2019; ADB, Report and Recommendation of the President, 2024).

ruta-del-cacao-santander.conditions_add: IDB Invest's environmental and social review summary for the Ruta del Cacao road concession (concession contract 013 of 2015, client Concesionaria Ruta del Cacao S.A.S.) states that a follow-up and control environmental and social action plan would be agreed with the concessionaire before financial close of the loan, and sets deadlines tied to disbursement. Before the first disbursement the concessionaire had to deliver a water efficiency programme with a construction-phase water consumption estimate, a fauna management protocol adjusted for species distribution and biological corridors, and updated land plans: a sociopredial management plan, a land acquisition plan, a socioeconomic compensation plan and a socioeconomic follow-up plan. Before the order to proceed on each functional unit it had to hold land records for at least 75 per cent of affected parcels by length, legal access to at least 40 per cent, and evidence of having started compensation for at least 50 per cent of the affected households that had agreed to the works. An emergency response and spill prevention plan for operation was due 90 days before construction ended, and a resettlement audit focused on vulnerable families two years after it ended (IDB Invest, Environmental and Social Review Summary, Ruta del Cacao).
